obligations.expected_behavior: When a verdict is issued, it traces to the current source identity.
obligations.observable_result: The verdict contains a traceable reference to the current source identity.
obligations.state_after: The verdict is linked to the current source identity.
obligations.state_before: A verdict is pending issuance and has no established source-identity trace.
obligations.subject: Every verdict

obligations.expected_behavior: When a verdict is issued, it is supported by real execution.
obligations.observable_result: The verdict has corresponding evidence of real execution.
obligations.state_after: The verdict is grounded in real execution evidence.
obligations.state_before: A verdict is pending issuance and has no established real-execution evidence.
obligations.subject: Every verdict

obligations.expected_behavior: Do not use assistant prose as the basis for establishing a verdict.
forbidden_result: A verdict is accepted solely because assistant prose asserts the result.
obligations.observable_result: The verdict can be substantiated by source identity and execution evidence without relying on assistant prose.
obligations.state_after: The verdict is established without assistant prose as its evidentiary basis.
obligations.state_before: A verdict is pending issuance and its evidentiary basis is not yet established.
obligations.subject: Every verdict
